ns2:section.sectionText: "Illinois Choral Conducting Symposium." Note: This course will meet June 25-30 only. The course offering is 1-3 variable credit hours The workshop begins at 6:00 PM on June 25 and concludes at 5:00 PM on June 30. Join other choral educator-conductors in a five-day workshop led by Dr. Andrew Megill, chair of the University of Illinois Choral division. As a conductor, you will experience daily lecture-demonstrations, podium time, and personal consultation with Dr. Megill. Repertoire to be studied and the topics examined will be sent to all participants. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/choralconductingworkshop/.
